# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue or discussion containing exploit details, credentials,
private payloads, or customer information.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/frost-leo/fathomry/security/advisories/new).
Include affected versions or commits, impact, a minimal safe reproduction, and
any mitigation you have tested. Do not send live credentials as proof.

If private reporting is unavailable, establish a private channel with the
maintainer before sharing sensitive details.

## Supported versions

There are no published supported release lines yet. Report findings against the
default branch or the exact affected commit. A release support policy will be
documented when releases are published; no response-time SLA is currently promised.
